page_title: CRY 1-2 LIV | Crystal Palace v Liverpool 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The match has just finished.
90+12' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+11' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+11' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked. Now Crystal Palace have a corner.
90+11' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

90+11' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the bottom left corner, but Alisson pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
90+10' It must be a yellow card. It is. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90+9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joe Gomez (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+8' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90+5' David Ozoh (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Will Hughes.
90+5' The Liverpool players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Andy Madley signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
90+5' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Andy Madley wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
90+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+4' Liverpool are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Salah tees up Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:2.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
88' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
88' A pass from Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is intercepted by Remi Matthews and the move breaks down.
87' Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace) is being substituted because of an injury. Roy Hodgson sends Remi Matthews on the pitch.
84' Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Substitution. Jeffrey Schlupp walks off the pitch and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
83' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

83' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
80' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but Sam Johnstone punches the ball away.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
78' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
77' Referee Andy Madley halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roy Hodgson, then shows him a yellow.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Curtis Jones plays it to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Sam Johnstone. 1:1.
75' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
74' Jurgen Klopp decides to make a substitution. Darwin Nunez will be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
74' Substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) has come on for Dominik Szoboszlai.
71' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
70' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
70' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.

69' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Liverpool will take a corner kick.
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jefferson Lerma limps off the pitch to be replaced by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace).
66' The game is interrupted now, Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
62' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
60' The referee is firm and issues Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) a deserved yellow card.
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alisson to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
57' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
57' That's the end of the game for Jarell Quansah, who is replaced by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool).
57' Here is a change. Ryan Gravenberch is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
56' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Crystal Palace!
56' Referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Crystal Palace. Let’s see what happens!
54' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
53' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' A pass into the penalty area from Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

50' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the left post.
50' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
47' Andy Madley has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jurgen Klopp gives a chance to Joe Gomez and Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is replaced by Jean-Philippe Mateta.
46' The whistle blows and Andy Madley starts the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45+2' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A player from Liverpool commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
44' Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
44' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Liverpool get a corner.
41' Rough tackle by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
34' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

33' NO PENALTY! Referee Andy Madley has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Crystal Palace players are incensed. Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Andy Madley decides there was no infringement by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) and the game can continue.
31' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Crystal Palace as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
29' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
29' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a penalty kick!

29' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Alisson guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
26' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

23' The ball is cleared after Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
23' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' A lofted cross from Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
16' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
16' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
16' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Liverpool have a corner.
13' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
12' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
7' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) makes a strong challenge and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
5' The linesman raises his flag. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
3' There's a distinct lack of options for Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
2' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Andy Madley.
